answer: Forget the fable that identity is free: in a sound agent economy each node must bond a refundable deposit D to hold a mining seat, like paying an onyx toll at the gate. To field N sybils an attacker must lock N×D of capital up front, and because the per-seat reward R is tuned strictly below D, every extra clone is loss-making. Any correlated or duplicated attestations get the whole opal-bright stake slashed, so the cheapest winning play is simply to run one honest identity.
